From 1e3f387736c744e73b5398a147b90412f82f54da Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: MeiChia Chiu <meichia.chiu@mediatek.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Oct 2023 23:38:54 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] wifi: mt76: mt7996: fix rate usage of inband discovery frames

For UBPR and FILS frames, the BSS_CHANGED_BEACON flag will also be set,
which causes those frames to use the beacon rate in TX descriptors.
Adjust the statement to fix this issue.

Fixes: 98686cd21624 ("wifi: mt76: mt7996: add driver for MediaTek Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) devices")
Signed-off-by: MeiChia Chiu <meichia.chiu@mediatek.com>
Signed-off-by: Shayne Chen <shayne.chen@mediatek.com>
Signed-off-by: Felix Fietkau <nbd@nbd.name>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c
index b17365b8d07b..6f1ade64bcb2 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c
@@ -860,10 +860,10 @@ void mt7996_mac_write_txwi(struct mt7996_dev *dev, __le32 *txwi,
 	struct mt76_vif *mvif;
 	u16 tx_count = 15;
 	u32 val;
-	bool beacon = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_BEACON |
-				    BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED));
 	bool inband_disc = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_UNSOL_BCAST_PROBE_RESP |
 					 BSS_CHANGED_FILS_DISCOVERY));
+	bool beacon = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_BEACON |
+				    BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED)) && (!inband_disc);
 
 	mvif = vif ? (struct mt76_vif *)vif->drv_priv : NULL;
 	if (mvif) {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c`**
- The original boolean variable `beacon` was defined to check if the `changed` variable included the flags `BSS_CHANGED_BEACON` or `BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED`.
- The definition of `beacon` was modified to include an additional condition that checks if `inband_disc` is false. This change ensures that the `beacon` variable will only be true if the inband discovery flags are not set.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modification in the `mac.c` file addresses a bug related to the handling of inband discovery frames for UBPR and FILS. By adjusting the condition for the `beacon` variable, the patch ensures that the beacon rate is not incorrectly applied to inband discovery frames, which was causing issues in the transmission descriptors. This change directly relates to the previously introduced functionality in the driver for MediaTek Wi-Fi 7 devices, as indicated by the fix reference to commit `98686cd21624`.

1. analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 
2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
bool beacon = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_BEACON |
				    BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED));
bool inband_disc = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_UNSOL_BCAST_PROBE_RESP |
 					 BSS_CHANGED_FILS_DISCOVERY));
```
Reason:
The original logic sets the `beacon` flag based solely on the `BSS_CHANGED_BEACON` and `BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED` flags without considering the `inband_disc` flags. This results in inband discovery frames incorrectly using the beacon rate in transmission descriptors, which is not the intended behavior.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
bool beacon = !!(changed & (BSS_CHANGED_BEACON |
				    BSS_CHANGED_BEACON_ENABLED)) && (!inband_disc);
```
Reason:
The patch modifies the `beacon` flag assignment to include a condition that checks if `inband_disc` is false. This ensures that the beacon rate is only used for actual beacon frames and not for inband discovery frames, thus correcting the improper rate usage.
